analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free in compound assignment handler: after zend_binary_op(var_ptr, var_ptr, value), the code unconditionally does ZVAL_COPY(EX_VAR(opline->result.var), var_ptr). For '/=' with string-to-number conversion, div_function() may call zval_ptr_dtor(result) when result==op1 (in-place op), freeing the original string held by var_ptr before writing the numeric result. The handler then copies from stale var_ptr, and ZVAL_COPY triggers GC_ADDREF on freed memory (crash in zend_gc_addref).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered by ASSIGN_OP on a VAR with TMPVAR RHS where RETURN_VALUE_USED(opline) is true (so result copy path runs), and an operator path that may dtor/free the old LHS when result==op1 (here division after prior concat-created string). Fuzzer input drives execution through ZEND_ASSIGN_OP_SPEC_VAR_TMPVAR_HANDLER -> zend_binary_op -> div_function freeing LHS string, then back to handler which copies var_ptr into result, causing UAF.
